title: Reporting Ops
teaser: Reporting automations and clustering-led checkpoint analysis for operations teams.
headline: A quieter operations layer built to remove reporting drag before it turned into management drag.
challenge: Manual reporting routines were too repetitive and too incomplete to support proactive operations.
outcome: Ali automated reporting flows and used clustering plus checkpoint analysis to improve completeness and make follow-up work more predictable.
bullets: Automated 12 reporting workflows using clustering and operational checkpoint analysis.
Expanded report completeness by 25% to support more proactive operational measures.
